column4: MXnet 1G Wall Plate Encoder
column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"u7o7s23264","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Clean, sleek, and stable. You get that when you install this AV over IP encoder device that fits into any standard dual-gang mud ring. Connect this MXnet wall plate to any HDMI source. It will encode the audio/video signal into a multicast data format that can be routed to any Decoder endpoint within the project/installation. This device connects directly via category cable (CAT 5e or better) to any MXnet switch. The AC-MXNET-1G-EWP is a part of the MXnet family of AV-over-IP products from AVPro Edge. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"q7brn23268","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"k95ak23281","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The AC-MXNET-1G-EWP will encode a 4K 4:2:0 30Hz HDMI video signal – along with audio, control, and power. These signals are passed to single or multiple Decoder endpoints via multicast routing through an MXnet or multicast compatible L3 managed network switch. MXnet Encoders encode audio/video/control signals into IP packets using an optimized JPEG2000 codec at a flexible data rate (200Mbps for 1080p content, 300Mbps for 4K30 content, 850Mbps at peak). It does all this with next to zero latency. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"fkcdh23270","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"skmgw23286","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The AC-MXNET-1G-EWP Encoder is only one part of the MXnet Ecosystem that includes Encoders, Network Switches, Control Processors, and other components designed to facilitate building a custom A/V distribution system. MXnet’s Ecosystem includes formatting such as resolution scaling, full EDID management, and multifaceted video walls. It includes the MXnet Mentor setup and control tool - making installations easy on the integrator while presenting a major WOW factor for your client.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"wtp9w23303","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"qhcuy23307","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"JPEG 2000","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" – JPEG 2000 is the obvious and essential video encoding choice when picture quality is critical.  JPEG 2000 supports progressive decoding and delivers both lossy and lossless compression within a code stream. JPEG 2000 supports GEN LOCK so that the frames of a video source are synced to all Decoders resulting in tear-free video walls. JPEG 2000 enables the handling of color-space information, 10bit color, and it supports interactivity in networked applications.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"awey623331","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"3m6g123349","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Full External Light Control","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" – Our integrators pride themselves on their work, so don’t let a small blue, green, red, or yellow light ruin your perfectly engineered viewing room. When you install an Encoder in a discreet location, you have the option to turn off ALL the lights on the device - including network link lights - as well as the Data Window OLED light. This allows you to install the Encoder, and once you know everything is working, eliminate any light outputted from the device.  This way, the end-user will never even know it’s there. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"n8szn23367","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"3hqsx23383","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Control Signal Routing","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" – Both RS-232 and IR signals can be direct routed through the AC-MXNET-1G-EWP Encoder.  When you route these signals through a network switch, you can specify either single or multiple Decoders to receive these control signals.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"dn4eo23401","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"el8b723417","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"USB and KVM Support","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" – Each Encoder unit has a USB-B Host connection. column4: 4K UHD Video over IP advanced control module for the Nice VIP platform
column5:
Integrate 4K Video over IP into your Nice smart home control system.

The Nice EL-4K-VIP-ACM Advanced Control Module brings the Nice Premium Video over IP (VIP) platform together, distributing HDMI video across a 1Gb network switch using visually lossless technology. Built-in Nice drivers simplify installation and remove the need to understand complex network infrastructure.

  • Designed to work with the Nice smart home control and automation platform

  • Optional web interface module with drag-and-drop source selection and video preview when used without a Nice control system

  • Advanced signal management for independent routing of IR, RS-232, USB/KVM, audio and video

Networking and control

  • Two RJ45 LAN connections bridge an existing network to the VIP video distribution network, separating traffic for better performance

  • Independent IP address per LAN connection with simplified TCP/IP, RS-232 and IR control

  • Powered via PoE with an optional local 12V supply; iOS and Android app control plus 3rd-party drivers for all major home control brands

Auto system configuration and no advanced network setup make the EL-4K-VIP-ACM a straightforward way to deploy whole-home 4K video distribution.

column4: 6.5-inch 2-way indoor/outdoor speaker, black or white
column5:
Unmatched high fidelity in a smaller package.

The Nice OE6 One Outdoor Elements speaker addresses a multitude of exterior applications and is available in black or white. A single 6.5" IMG cone woofer loaded into a ported enclosure dramatically enhances low-frequency response for deep, full bass that complements any type of music.

  • One 6.5" IMG cone woofer with rubber surround for deep, full bass

  • One pivoting 1" liquid-cooled treated silk dome tweeter

  • Ported enclosure that enhances low-frequency response

Built for the outdoors

  • Drivers made from space-age polymers, injection-molded graphite or aluminum for sonic purity

  • Timbre-matched across all three Outdoor Elements series speakers

  • 4 Ohm impedance with 125W power handling

A versatile, full-bodied indoor/outdoor speaker for patios, pergolas and covered exterior spaces.

column4: FULLY DIGITAL IMMERSIVE SOUND PROCESSOR
column5:
Description

The ISP Evo is the first purely digital immersive sound processor on the home cinema market. Built on a fully digital signal path with AES/EBU and AoIP (AES67/Dante) interfaces, it is the only processor capable of interfacing directly with Digital Cinema Processors playing DCP content and delivering up to 32 channels in digital format over the network.

Up to 32 channels of decoding and upmixing handle every major immersive format — Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D, IMAX Enhanced, MPEG-H and Sony 360 Reality Audio — with up to 32 channels of post-processing. HDMI 2.1 with HDCP 2.3 supports 8K/40 Gbps, HDR10+, Dolby Vision and HLG pass-through across all seven inputs and two eARC outputs.

Dirac Live Room Correction, Dirac Live Bass Control and Dirac Live Active Room Treatment all ship as standard, paired with StormAudio's Expert Bass Management for full-range reference performance in the most demanding installations.

column4: LINEAR RESPONSE - INVISIBLE SPEAKERS
column5:
Full Range, 2-Way Invisible In-Wall or In-Ceiling Speaker

The Stealth Acoustics model LR6G is a 2-way, full-range speaker system that becomes completely invisible after installation. The loudspeaker has a rigid frame that attaches directly to standard structural framing. The paintable active diaphragm face is bonded to the frame of the speaker panel, creating an active area surrounded by a stable mounting area. 

The Stealth Acoustics LR6G incorporates an acoustically coupled, high-power 6.5” cone woofer and a direct coupled 30 mm neo-magnet high-frequency motor. Advanced internal carbon fiber materials allow for smooth frequency extension to 20kHz. When the LR6G is installed in standard insulated 2” x 4” framing and allowed to function in a full 8 foot stud bay, frequency response below 45Hz can be achieved. The LR6G contains two independent protection circuits (high-frequency and low-frequency sections) that automatically reset upon reduction of excessive amplifier power.

The LR6G may be installed in either the wall or ceiling and on-site finishing options include latex paint, light wallpaper, fabrics and selected texture coats. There is no need for special vellums or other nonstandard wallboard finishing materials. Advanced finishing methods such as Venetian plaster and select veneers are supported using special techniques.

column4: LINEAR RESPONSE - INVISIBLE SPEAKERS
column5:
3-Way Full-Range Seven-Element System

The model LRX-85 invisible speaker is a premium, 3-way, two panel system The LRX-85 is truly a powerful and complete full-range solution, requiring no special bass-limiting filters, ancillary protection circuits or external subwoofers. For even greater ability, an active, bi-amplified LRX-85ACT version is also available.

300watt power handling enables output up to 105dB with premium extendedrange sound quality. The LRX-85 performs as an exemplary invisible speaker in a wide range of applications, including home theaters, high-impact distributed audio and critical listening environments where aesthetic needs demand no visible presence of a loudspeaker.

The LRX-85 utilizes separate, easy to install, flat front panels for mid-high and bass reproduction, improving performance while minimizing intermodulation distortion. The two panels may be mounted as far a 1meter apart and still provide quality outcomes.

The mid-high panel incorporates four 25watt neodymium midrange motors and one 25watt neodymium high-frequency motor aligned in Stealth’s Quad-Balanced Midrange Drive™ configuration. Advanced internal materials and smooth sounding FidelityGlass™ panel face allow for upper frequency response to 20 kHz. A multi-stage passive crossover is provided to allow a single speaker line from the amplifier to feed both mid-high and bass panels. The LRX-85 crossover contains three independent self-resetting protection circuits to protect the speaker from excessive amplifier power, ensuring maximum long-term reliability.

The separate dual 8” high-power cone woofer bass-stage panel provides extended bass response down to 35Hz when the panel is installed in a recommended back box and properly tuned. The result is an impressive sounding loudspeaker rivaling visible alternatives.

Stealth Acoustics’ invisibility offers a powerful advantage over traditional loudspeakers because they can be placed wherever they sound best, free of visual concerns that may conflict with architectural features. The LRX-85 is designed to be installed into standard wall or ceiling constructions with many on-site finishing options that include paint, light wallpaper, fabrics, wood veneers, vinyl graphics and selected texture coats. There is no need for non-standard wallboard finishing materials. Installation instructions are shown on a paper overlay that is to be removed before installation. The overlay can also be used as a cutting template for retrofitting the speakers into existing wallboard. Unique mounting and advanced finishing methods may be accomplished using special techniques.

column4: High-performance 3.5-inch small-aperture in-ceiling speaker
column5:
Dynamic, impactful sound in a compact, design-friendly form factor.

The SC-IC3 High Performance 3.5" In-Ceiling Speaker delivers dynamic and impactful sound in a compact package. Leveraging advanced technology and materials, its high-excursion carbon fiber woofer, proportionately massive aluminum tweeter, and custom crossover design make it a top choice for premium performance without compromising aesthetics. Both round and square grilles are included, with optional flush mount kits, to satisfy the most fastidious designers needs.

  • 3.5" carbon fiber woofer for transparent, low-distortion sound

  • 1" aluminum tweeter for dynamic detail at a lower crossover point

  • Custom crossover with proprietary Capacitor Filter/Boost Circuitry for rich bass

  • 4.75" cut-out size for quick retrofit installs with a standard hole saw

Designed as a system

  • Engineered in tandem with the SC-IC-SUB8 Small Aperture in-ceiling subwoofer

  • Includes two low-profile, paintable round and square grilles

An optional flush mount mudbank lets the grille sit flush with the surface for a near-invisible aesthetic.

column4: Series 3 8-inch toolless in-ceiling speaker with AccuAim tweeter
column5:
Reference-grade in-ceiling sound with deep, powerful bass.

The Nice SC3-IC8 is the largest single-woofer model in the flagship Series 3 line, pairing an 8 inch black Kevlar woofer with an oversized aluminum/magnesium dome tweeter for the deepest low-end and highest output in the family. It is engineered for premium home theaters and elevated listening spaces.

  • 8 inch black Kevlar woofer reaching down to 36 Hz for powerful, articulate bass

  • Proportionally massive 1 1/4 inch (30mm) aluminum/magnesium dome tweeter lowers the crossover point for exceptional imagery

  • XMag longer pole piece ensures precise linearity and accurate reproduction

AccuAim and ViseLock technologies

  • Proprietary AccuAim aiming enables precise, lockable tweeter positioning for enhanced phase accuracy

  • ViseLock toolless mounting system designed by Swarm enables installs up to 75% faster than conventional systems

  • Electroplated painted steel grill resists rust and is paintable to match any ceiling

Available in dual-tweeter (DT) and TILT variants and compatible with the optional FRBC-UNI 1-hour fire-rated cover. Backed by a 5 year warranty.

Through precise control over strict USB specification timing requirements with physical transmission media, including both Category wire and fiber, ExtremeUSB manages turnaround time quotients in the USB protocol between the local point and all remote points. ExtremeUSB® maintains these transmission and acknowledgment requirements transparently and driver-free. column4: Passive portable 12-inch coaxial speaker
column5:

column4: 6.5-inch aluminum-cone indoor/outdoor speaker, black or white
column5:
Unmatched high fidelity in a smaller package.

The Nice OE6 Three Outdoor Elements speaker addresses a multitude of exterior applications and is available in black or white. A single 6.5" aluminum cone woofer loaded into a ported enclosure dramatically enhances low-frequency response for deep, full bass that complements any type of music.

  • One 6.5" aluminum cone woofer with rubber surround for crisp, articulate bass

  • One pivoting 1" liquid-cooled aluminum dome tweeter

  • Ported enclosure that enhances low-frequency response

Built for the outdoors

  • Drivers made from space-age polymers, injection-molded graphite or aluminum for sonic purity

  • Timbre-matched across all three Outdoor Elements series speakers

  • 4 Ohm impedance with 125W power handling and 90 dB efficiency

A high-efficiency aluminum-driver outdoor speaker for patios, pergolas and covered exterior spaces.

column4: 6-inch 2-way outdoor landscape satellite speaker
column5:
Bold outdoor performance with long-lasting durability.

The Nice SC-OG-6 brings the bold audio performance of Nice architectural speakers to outdoor spaces of all sizes. Its 6" driver and compact satellite form factor blend into any landscape while delivering the Nice signature sound across the backyard.

  • Weather-resistant fiberglass-reinforced ABS enclosure built to withstand harsh climates

  • 110-degree wide sound dispersion from a 2-way design for clear, even coverage

  • 8 Ohm or 70V/100V operation for flexible system scaling

Versatile installation

  • Selectable 70V/100V tap settings allow individual volume control of every speaker

  • Quick-connect stake, surface and conduit mounting accessories available (sold separately)

  • Rugged enough to stand up to outdoor garden equipment, including weed whackers

A complete landscape audio solution that pairs with Nice in-ground subwoofers for full-range outdoor sound.

column4: MXnet 1G Evolution II Downmixing Encoder
column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"spjxu9719","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Tracing the footprints of AVPro Edge’s AC-MXNET-1G-EV2 and continuing down the evolutionary path of the MXnet Platform, the AC-MXNET-1G-AVDM-EV2 draws upon an onboard proprietary audio decoder module designed to extract two-channel balanced analog audio from high bitrate, multi-channel audio codecs including Dolby Atmos and DTS:X IMAX Enhanced for integration with multi-zone stereo distribution systems. Downmixed signals are extracted and output in analog stereo via a balanced Phoenix-type terminal on the encoder chassis.  ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"owbtc9721","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"hgfpc9723","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The AC-MXNET-1G-AVDM-EV2 functions otherwise as an Evolution II Encoding/Transmitting device, incorporating a newly designed AVPro Edge application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) that introduces an improved software-based video encoding/decoding engine into the IC for enhanced video processing. Refinements to the IC include native support for 4K/60fps 4:4:4 signals (RGB and YCbCr @10- and 12-bit). All MXnet first-generation encoder features are retained for use with the AC-MXNET-1G-AVDM-EV2. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"vj4wz9725","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"f3c0q9727","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"As a member of the AVPro Edge family of AV over IP products, an AC-MXNET-1G-AVDM-EV2 is a gateway where a signal enters the MXnet Ecosystem, connected with category cable (AVPro Edge strongly encourages CAT-6a infrastructure for all MXnet system deployments however for MXnet 1G, Cat-5e will comfortably transport MXnet 1G data signals) or fiber optic cabling, to an MXnet switch or any compatible multicast-capable managed L3 network switch.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"6kxrm9729","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"mcupd9731","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"A connected HDMI source will have audio and video signals encoded into a multicast data format for routing to any AC-MXNET-1D-EV2 system endpoint connected to the same MXnet switch. Encoded HDMI source signals up to native 4K/60fps 4:4:4 with Dolby Vision, HDR10, HDR10+, and HLG are passed to EVO II downstream AC-MXNET-1G-DV2 decoders, with RS-232 serial pass-through, IR control or USB signals also transportable inside encoded data packets.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"8ajg29733","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"ora9o9734","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Encoding is executed using an optimized JPEG 2000 codec, which parses data at managed flexible rates to minimize bitrate errors (200Mbps for 1080p content, 300Mbps for 4K/30fps content, peaking at 850Mbps for 4K/60fps content). Frame-syncing Genlock is supported, with latency near zero and visually imperceptible. The AC-MXNET-1G-AVDM-EV2 runs quietly and remains cool during operation, utilizing a fan-less design featuring chip-top heatsinking to efficiently disperse heat while limiting power consumption at typically 7 watts or less for stability and device longevity. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"3tqfe9739","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"6sk3b9741","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"PLEASE NOTE THE FOLLOWING: MXNET-1G-AVDM EV2 and AC-MXNET-1G-DV2 devices may coexist alongside MXnet first-generation encoders and decoders within previously installed systems or pending system deployments; however, they are required to be used exclusively in EVO II transmitter-to-EVO II decoder(s) pairings only.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"pmykt9807","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"ykyji9814","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Downmixing","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" – Supports transmission of high bitrate multi-channel audio codecs through an MXnet system while allowing simultaneous extraction and division of digital and analog audio signals. Standard Dolby Audio & DTS-HD formats up to 7.1 may be downmixed and output as balanced analog stereo audio. Dolby Atmos 7.1 base channels and DTS:X IMAX Enhanced audio soundtracks may also be decoded then downmixed into analog stereo output for distribution through non-surround products.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"nwokq9850","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"09p8o9876","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"JPEG 2000 – ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"JPEG 2000 encoding implemented by MXnet differs from MPEG and other discrete cosine transform-based codecs, as it optimizes compression efficiency for applications with limited bandwidth. JPEG 2000 is based on a wavelet transform algorithm, providing lossless or lossy compression and parseable code streams. Genlock is supported, syncing a video source by frame to Decoders comprising a video wall, for a simul-sync, tear-free appearance. JPEG 2000 is reliably used by Digital Cinema Initiatives for theatrical content, by television networks for HD broadcasting, and by DICOM® for critical, decision-making, medical imaging applications.  ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"qpfys9904","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"8ffln9930","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Native 4K/60fps Support – ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"First-generation MXnet Encoders and Decoders were unable to support 4K/60fps 4:4:4 RGB or YCbCr, 10- and 12-bit natively or with dynamic metadata. When not lossless, the advanced encoding / decoding engine resident on the new ASIC developed for EVO II Encoders and Decoders applies a limited, ultra-light compression, composing an artifact free image upon decoding, including Dolby Vision or HDR10+ content. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"sxzlx9958","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"zcufa9985","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Improved Preview Thumbnails -","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" First generation MXnet supported static thumbnails with 960X540 pixel resolution, turning over every 10 seconds. EVO II supports third-party media sub-streaming through an HTTP address, at an improved pixel resolution of 1024x576.   ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"sqjfj10015","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"euo0p10042","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Data Status Window – ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"A forward-facing, built-in mini OLED screen displays information critical to device set up, system troubleshooting, or standard operational status. Custom name an EVO II AC-MXNET-1G-AVDM-EV2 with up to twelve allotted character slots for easy identification or to match your system requirements. IP and MAC addresses are also displayed.  ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"x23fw10098","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"g98xx10125","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Control Signal Routing – ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"IR and RS-232 control signal routes that have been mapped with MXnet Mentor software direct commands to downstream EVO II decoders through the AC-MXNET-1G-AVDM -V2. Any EVO II decoder connected to an MXnet system switch may be eligible to receive routed signals. I-PASS and IR-EYE ports support IR signal throughput from third-party over-control systems to endpoint-related products. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"x154w10179","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"qjf1f10205","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"USB and KVM Support – ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"A USB 2.0 Type-B female Host connection resides on every AC-MXNET-AVDM-1G-EV2. MXnet Mentor software enables easy routing configuration for bi-directional USB signals from a designated Host Encoder to a downstream decoder with a connected USB device. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"7x0ls10233","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"32wui10259","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"External Device Light Control – ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Light emission from an AC-MXNET-1G-AVDM-EV2 may be controlled via MXnet Mentor. Any status light, including network link LEDs and the OLED Data Window may be optionally disabled to prevent unwanted distraction, enabling discreet placement where desired. Device lights may also be continuously “flashed” for high visibility when troubleshooting.    ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"9fnuj9837","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"4e5iy9839","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Netgear Support –","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" MXnet’s engineers have worked together with Netgear to ensure their switches work with our line of encoders and decoders. To make installing MXnet with Netgear switches even easier, Netgear has developed an “AVPro Edge Profile.” Once this is loaded, your switch will work seamlessly with the AVPro Edge encoder and decoders. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"}],"metadata":{"version":1,"createdTimestamp":"2022-12-19T17:56:18.279Z","updatedTimestamp":"2022-12-19T17:56:18.279Z","id":"0cbc89c8-9976-49ec-87cb-c53e065cd0de"},"documentStyle":{}}

column4: LINEAR RESPONSE - INVISIBLE SPEAKERS
column5:
Full Range, Invisible In-Wall or In-Ceiling Speaker
(DISCONTINUED)

The Stealth Acoustics model LR3G is a 3-way, full-range speaker system that becomes completely invisible after installation. The speaker has a rigid frame that attaches directly to standard structural framing. The paintable active diaphragm face is bonded to the frame of the speaker panel, creating an active area surrounded by a stable mounting area. 

The Stealth Acoustics LR3G incorporates an acoustically coupled high-power 8” cone woofer with 3 directly coupled 25 mm neo-magnet high-frequency motors. Advanced internal carbon fiber materials allow for smooth frequency extension to 20 kHz. When the LR3G is installed in standard insulated 2” x 4” framing and allowed to function in a full 8 foot stud bay, frequency response below 45 Hz can be achieved. The LR3G contains three independent protection circuits (low, mid-range and high frequency sections) that automatically reset upon reduction of excessive amplifier power.

The LR3G may be installed in either the wall or ceiling and on-site finishing options include latex paint, light wallpaper, fabrics and selected texture coats. There is no need for special vellums or other nonstandard wallboard finishing materials. Advanced finishing methods such as Venetian plaster and select veneers are supported using special techniques.

column5:

Whether you prefer power over Ethernet (POE) or DC (Coming Soon, but not yet available) , this panel has you covered, featuring a built-in dual microphone and speaker, along with an ambient light sensor. It’s even capable of functioning as an intercom, making it ideal for small areas, bedrooms, entrances, or any space that requires a compact screen. 

Rest assured, this top-notch device is curated, customized, imported, sold, shipped, and fully supported by Innovo, offering a unique and specialized experience. This exceptional product is not manufactured by the Nice, Control 4, Lutron or Rako corporation.

column4: OUTDOOR CEILING SPEAKERS
column5:
The KW12M, outdoor ceiling speakers are designed to satisfy the needs of architects and installators. Thanks to the AISI 316 stainless steel structure, the loudspeakers are especially suitable to be installed in pools, saunas and on yachts. State-of-the-art components and high-quality materials, for a premium and lasting audio performance.

Minimal design and endless customisation possibilities

Timeless design and steel structure accompanied by various and elegant finishes, colours and customisations solutions of both the cabinet and the grid or of the cloth covering the speaker.

Premium listening experience

We approach every aspect of the designing and building with the aim of delivering a superior sound performance: light sound, natural, relaxing, and realistic acoustic scene.  That’s why we only choose state-of-the-art electronic components. Our speakers are completely designed and manufactured in in Italy and are tested one by one.

Easy installation and superior versatility

Regardless of budget, size of the environment, type of mounting technology (wall, ceiling or on furniture or shelves), and listening experience and performances (stereo, multi-room, home theatre), [CORO] speakers represent the right solution for every need and are extremely easy to install.
column6:
Solidity

Made of materials resistant to the harshest weather conditions such as rain, sun, frost and salt. SNW14M are outdoor ceiling speakers of timeless charm, offering a 3-year warranty on all components.

Customisation

In addition to the standard finishes, KW12M outdoor ceiling speakers also come in Corten® effect and can be lacquered in all RAL colours, upon request, in order to satisfy every need of our customers.

column4: OUTDOOR SUBWOOFER
column5:
The WA125 outdoor subwoofer is enriched in Corian® and is designed for an outdoor installation and listening experience. State-of-the-art components and high-quality materials, for a premium audio performance and resitance even to the coldes temperatures.

NEW MARBLE EFFECT PORCELAIN FINISH

For our outdoor subwoofer, we introduce the new marble effect porcelain finish, combining 360-degree sound excellence with a timeless design. This element is designed to integrate perfectly with the aesthetics of outdoor environments, maintaining its elegance and functionality in any weather condition.

Designed for your outdoor spaces

The WA125 outdoor subwoofer is designed for outdoor installation and feature an essential and geometric design, optimised fixing solutions for swimming pools, parks, terraces, verandas, also in Corian and a in a wide choice of finishes.

Superior outdoor listening experience

We approach every aspect of the designing and building of our speakers with the aim of delivering a superior sound performance outdoor. The sound is natural, light and spreads in all directions minimising the number of speakers required, thanks to the acoustic lens and the maximum ratio between power and size. Garvan-designed outdoor subwoofers are 100% Made in Italy and feature state-of-the-art electronic components. Plus, every and each loudspeaker is individually tested.
column6:
Solidity

Made of materials resistant to the harshest weather conditions such as rain, sun, frost and salt. WA125 is an outdoor subwoofer of timeless charm, offering a 3-year warranty on all components.

Customisation

In addition to the standard finishes in white, green and grey, WA125 outdoor subwoofer also comes in Corten® effect, in Gres and can be lacquered in all RAL colours, upon request, in order to satisfy every need of our customers.

column4: Flagship rack-mount system controller with Z-Wave for demanding installations
column5:
The premium control center for the connected home.

The Nice EL-SC-350 is the premium control center for the connected home, bringing together all your intelligent devices to work as one seamless system. Control media, lighting, climate, pool/spa, irrigation, and more through a single app interface. As the flagship Nice controller, it gives you the ultimate flexibility for a system of virtually any size.

  • Extensive connectivity: RS-232, RS-485, Relays, IR, IP, input sensors and Z-Wave control

  • ARM big.LITTLE architecture integrating dual-core and quad-core processors

  • HDMI 2.0 for 4K 60Hz output with HDCP 1.4/2.2 support and H.265 decoding up to 4K

Built for any installation

  • Z-Wave control and automation of compatible devices built in

  • Single rack space form factor with rack mount hardware included

  • PoE ready and expandable with the EL-IO-200 Control Extender for large or decentralized installations

Consistent themes and layouts across Nice touch panels, remotes, and mobile apps deliver a multi-platform experience.

column4: High-performance 8.27-inch small-aperture in-ceiling subwoofer with 4.75-inch opening
column5:
Best-in-class deep bass through a small, finished ceiling opening.

The SC-IC-SUB8 high-performance small-aperture in-ceiling subwoofer delivers best-in-class deep bass through a discreet 4.75" finished opening to meet the aesthetic needs of the modern home. The woofer cabinet hides between ceiling joists, porting low-frequency sound through the small opening. It features a custom 8.27" polypropylene woofer, dual 1.5" voice coils, a precision-tuned port tube, and a vinyl-wrapped MDF cabinet mounted to a single joist.

  • Custom 8.27" polypropylene cone maximized to the cabinet proportions

  • Dual voice coil for stereo wiring or single-channel use with included shorting bars

  • Analog filtering circuits with a 10 mH inductor per voice coil for deep, clear bass

  • 4.75" cut-out installs with a standard hole saw

Designed as a system

  • Engineered in the USA in tandem with the SC-IC3 speaker and SC4-100 amplifier

  • Delivers three-way, full-range sound optimized for aesthetics and flexibility

Simple single-joist mounting with integrated absorption pads reduces kinetic transmission through the structure.

column4: Digital and Analog Audio over IP – Sender. Extend and Distribute Analog and Digital Audio, RS-232, and IR over a Local Area Network
column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"16z0r1639","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Gefen AV over IP solutions continue our tradition of providing high performance, scalable, expandable, and secure AV routing and distribution over a standard Gigabit Local Area Network. The Digital and Analog Audio over IP Sender (EXT-ADA-LAN-TX) and Receiver (EXT-ADA-LAN-RX) are new additions to Gefen's family of AV over IP products, offering a much-needed audio-only option for background music, public announcements, and other applications where stand-alone audio needs to be distributed through the AV system. Audio input and output options include L/R Analog, Coaxial Digital, and Optical Digital. When using the digital inputs and outputs, 2-channel PCM and up to 5.1 channels of Bitstream can be distributed through the system. column4: Control Extender
column5: The EL-IO-200 gives the ultimate flexibility in control. Paired with an ELAN® EL-SC-100, EL-SC-300, or a gSC Series controller, the EL-IO-200 extends control to additional media and smart-home devices not placed near the main controller. Setup in a bedroom, guest house, or pool house. Connected to the main controller over the network (Wired or Wirelessly), the EL-IO-200 extends RS-232, RS-485, Relays, IR, IP, and sensor inputs to control devices without the need for long cable runs or third-party extenders.

column4: Compact 10-inch triple-driver subwoofer with single active and dual passive radiators
column5:
Premium performance and unbeatable value in a compact 10-inch subwoofer.

The Nice SDSi-10 carries on the Sunfire subwoofer legacy, built on decades of bass innovation and patents. A triple-driver configuration pairs one 10" active polypropylene cone with dual 10" passive polypropylene radiators, driven by an exclusive Class-D amplifier for deep, immersive bass in a compact, hideaway cabinet wrapped in a beautiful matte black finish.

  • Triple-driver configuration: single active driver with dual passive radiators

  • Exclusive Class-D amplifier design

  • Beautiful matte black finish cabinet

  • Built-in 5V USB with integrated mount to support wireless audio

Flexible placement

  • Optional wireless audio kit allows placement anywhere in a room

  • Compact passive-radiator design keeps a smaller, hideaway profile

From the moment it is installed, you will understand exactly why not all subwoofers are created equal.

With the unmatched pedigree of AVPro Edge behind it tradition never fails, as the AC-MX-88X lets you break convention and seek perfection. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"ed1xr12399","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"5g8xc12402","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"NOTE TO DESIGNERS, INSTALLERS, AND TECHNICIANS","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700},{"type":"ITALIC","italicData":true}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"k2iym12406","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"When used with an AVR or a Pre-processor as an HDMI video bypass around outdated onboard AVR or Pre-processor HDMI video signal technology, especially when introducing a Next-Gen video display into a system while retaining an existing AVR or Pre-processor that remains compatible with current immersive audio codec reproduction, the following must be noted: When the main HDMI video display output of the bypassed AVR or Pre-processor is left untethered to an EDID-producing device, the AVR or Pre-processor has no means for EDID negotiation or authentication. As a result, source devices fail to detect an active EDID-managed HDMI path. An AVR or Pre-processor may not fully activate or switch to the desired input for audio capture if no active output is detected or fails to enable proper input signal processing.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"ITALIC","italicData":true}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"891xk12408","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"BEST PRACTICE is for the AVR or Pre-processor to terminate into a device that produces an active EDID, which serves to “trick” the AVR or Pre-processor into continuing to function as designed (with a video signal and multi-channel audio selected at one of its inputs, expected to transfer the video signal to a display device with EDID authentication). An AVPro Edge AC-SC-1X or AC-DA12-AUHD-GEN2 with EDID management is ideal for overcoming this anomaly as both have EDID management capabilities; however, any device capable of producing an EDID compatible with maintaining the AVR’s or Pre-processor’s stability may be utilized.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"ITALIC","italicData":true}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"jhokg12421","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"ku87y12427","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Perfect For AVR Bypass ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"~ Clients often take a measured approach to system upgrades and frequently the initial step is a television that accommodates the latest Next-Gen gaming console that was on every Christmas list. But many end-users soon become painfully aware their previous upgrade, an AVR for object-oriented surround-sound, is unable to pass the gaming console’s best image quality to the new display. Tasking the AC-MX-88X for video chores and bypassing the dated AVR, which otherwise remains perfectly viable for audio use, offers clients upgrade “breathing room” to system rebuild at their pace. An additional AVPro Edge product is required, however, and is key to accomplishing the workaround. An AC-SC-1X, inserted into the signal path between the switcher output that serves the television, stealthily contributes to the heavy lifting. AC-SC-1X faithfully passes video signals up to 8K 60Hz (4:2:0), as its secondary HDMI output downconverts the signal into a bandwidth range the AVR can contend with. column4: Environmentally Durable Sound
column5:
Full Range, 8″ 3-Way High Performance Speaker

The StingRay83 is Stealth Acoustics’ highest-performing outdoor full-range speaker featuring deep bass and sparkling highs combined with ultra-wide dispersion characteristics.

StingRay83 speakers feature an advanced driver set that incorporates an acoustically coupled, high-power, 8″ cone woofer with directly-coupled high and mid-frequency drivers for frequency extension ranging from 40Hz to 20kHz.

The StingRay83 contains two independent protection circuits (low and high-frequency sections) that automatically reset upon reduction of excessive amplifier power.

Invisible Impervious Speakers

StingRay speakers are known for raising the bar in outdoor audio durability and sound quality, and deliver smooth mid and high-frequency response with a solid, rich bass extension and are ideal for luxury residential, commercial, and marine applications. StingRay speakers combine direct coupled motor technology with an acoustic lever technology driven by a traditional woofer to energize the entire FidelityGlass™ active surface of the speaker panel resulting in crisp highs and impactful bass.

The sleek design and versatile mounting options mean the speakers won’t be an eyesore. To further enhance the aesthetic, Stealth offers custom finishing options so your speakers can Blend In! or Stand Out!

column4: Series 2 6.5-inch toolless in-ceiling speaker for gaming and streaming
column5:
Immersive sound for gaming, streaming, and distributed audio.

The Nice SC2-IC6 is a Series 2 premium toolless in-ceiling speaker built for immersive gaming, music streaming, and whole-home distributed audio. Its anodized ceramic/aluminum 6.5 inch woofer and matching anodized ceramic/aluminum dome tweeter deliver crisp, dynamic, detailed sound.

  • 6.5 inch anodized ceramic/aluminum woofer for explosive dynamics

  • 1 inch (25mm) deep anodized ceramic/aluminum dome tweeter for accurate detail

  • XMag longer pole piece ensures precise linearity and accurate reproduction

ViseLock toolless installation

  • ViseLock mounting system designed by Swarm enables installs up to 75% faster than conventional systems

  • Electroplated painted steel grill resists rust and is paintable to match any ceiling

Available in a TILT variant and compatible with the optional FRBC-UNI 1-hour fire-rated cover. Backed by a 5 year warranty.

Installation applications for house-of-worship, education, hotel/conference, and restaurant/retail with support equipment such as mixers, SD/USB recorders, and computer-related audio may use Dante devices for high quality, near-zero latency distribution of voice and music signaling. column4: Dual 12-inch force-canceling powered subwoofer with onboard DSP
column5:
The new pinnacle of sound technology, pushing the envelope for ultra-high-performance subwoofers.

The Nice XTEQi-12 features dual 12" force-canceling active Kevlar drivers, each powered by a dedicated 1000W amplifier, with onboard DSP offering wireless setup and control via a mobile app. It accurately reproduces low frequencies down to 17Hz, delivering an experience that can be both felt and heard, ideal for music in listening rooms and home cinemas.

  • Force-canceling dual active Kevlar High Back-EMF drivers in a perfectly opposed configuration

  • High-gloss piano black lacquer finish over a 1" MDF cabinet

  • Bi-amplified design with a dedicated 1000W amplifier per driver

  • Optional wireless audio kit for flexible placement

Sub Station app and auto setup

  • Intuitive Sub Station app manages tuning and eliminates setup complexity

  • Auto-EQ with DSP room correction at the push of a button

Crafted to complement other high-end A/V components, bringing unprecedented sound performance and beauty to every environment.

column4: Series 2 8-inch toolless in-ceiling speaker for gaming and streaming

  • 1 1/4 inch (30mm) anodized ceramic/aluminum dome tweeter lowers the crossover point for exceptional imagery

column4: Environmentally Durable Sound
column5:
The Most Durable Outdoor Subwoofer

The StingRay430 is a high-powered, environ­mentally protected outdoor subwoofer system utilizing eight acoustically coupled, high-power, 8″ cone woofers (2 per side) to create space-filling, outdoor bass for frequency extension ranging from 20Hz to 100Hz.

Using acoustic lever principals, the StingRay430 provides exceptional bass output by trading excursion for surface area to generate bass.

Invisible Impervious Speakers

The StingRay430 subwoofer is raises the bar in outdoor audio durability and sound quality, delivering a smooth, rich bass extension. It is ideal for luxury residential, commercial, and marine applications. StingRay speakers and subwoofers combine direct coupled motor technology with an acoustic lever technology driven by a traditional woofer to energize the entire FidelityGlass™ active surface(s) of the speaker resulting in crisp highs and impactful bass.

The sleek design and black or white color option means the subwoofer won’t be an eyesore. To further enhance the aesthetic, Stealth offers custom finishing options so your subwoofer can Blend In! or Stand Out!

column4: INVISIBLE SPEAKERS
column5:
2-Way 8th Generation Invisible Loudspeaker

The LineaRadiance 116 (LR116) is a compact, background music application invisible speaker. Its small footprint makes for easy installation into almost any location. It features a high-power, 6.5” cone woofer with one directly-coupled high-frequency driver.


LineaRadiance speakers are the 8th generation and next evolution of Stealth Acoustics’ LineaResponse flat radiating diaphragm speakers first released in 2003. Up to 5 new LineaRadiance speaker models are planned for release in 2024 for a full ‘family’ of 8th-generation invisible speaker/subwoofer offerings.

New features for LineaRadiance Speakers:

  • Integrated, acoustically tuned back box included with every speaker (removable)

  • New transducer/exciter driver designs

  • Increased overall efficiency

  • Fidelity Glass Advanced™ tuned and dampened fiber diaphragm

  • Easy-Tape™ tapered frame/diaphragm for improved finishing

  • Increased power handling

  • Re-voiced crossover networks

  • Increased overall diaphragm surface areas on many models

  • The new woofer mount for increased internal air volume

  • Improved poly-switches

  • New paper-finish diaphragm for better material adhesion

column5:

The cabinet and port design are computer-optimized to deliver deep, distortion-free bass that fills your outdoor space.

  • 10" mica-injected polypropylene woofer for deep, full bass

  • Up to 300W power handling with a low-impedance 8 Ohm design

Built for the elements

  • High-flow port and canopy assembly spreads air in a 360-degree pattern to eliminate port noise

  • Critter-proof aluminum mesh grille keeps water, dirt, bugs and animals out

  • Discreet canopy blends naturally into landscaping

column4: 16-CHANNEL IMMERSIVE SOUND PROCESSOR
column5:
Description

The ISP Core 16 is StormAudio's gateway into reference-grade immersive processing — a French-engineered 16-channel preamp/processor that brings the same Dirac Live calibration toolkit and bass-management philosophy as the flagship Elite into a more streamlined chassis. It decodes and upmixes Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D and IMAX Enhanced, with legacy codec support up to 192 kHz.

Seven HDMI inputs and two HDMI outputs with eARC handle 4K UHD with HDR10, Dolby Vision and HLG (HDMI 2.0b / HDCP 2.2 stock, with an HDMI 2.1 upgrade board available for 8K and 48 Gbps).

Dirac Live, Dirac Live Bass Control and Dirac Live Active Room Treatment ship as standard, with up to 20 PEQs per channel, four-way active crossovers and unlimited subwoofers — giving custom installers a complete platform for sophisticated cinema layouts.

column4: HANGING SPEAKER
column5:
Goccia is the only hanging speaker that blends natural sound diffusion with design and art. A decorative piece of furniture, totally made in Faenza’s ceramic, with a timeless design, suspended from the ground thanks to state-of-the-art components.


Pure sound

Garvan’s concept of “pure sound” draws inspiration from an ideal suspended spherical loudspeaker, which recreates a real-life acoustic condition, providing a natural and crystal-clear sound. This is made possible by state-of-the-art components, Italian craftsmanship and individual tuning of each speaker.

Timeless design

Our timeless design allows bringing the possibilities of suspended lighting techniques into your sound diffusion solutions, creating refined pieces of furniture, with sinuous shapes inspired by nature, available in various colours.

A unique ceramic work of art from Faenza

Every ceramic product is unique and unrepeatable, because it is manufactured individually by the expert hands of the Masters of the well-known Gatti Ceramic Workshop in Faenza. Exclusive finishes are available drawing from our culture and history: traditional decoration patterns from Faenza, a motorbike theme inspired by the Misano World Circuit and signed by the renowned designer Aldo Drudi (ADI Golden Compass Award), breath-taking pearl effects, noble metals (gold, platinum and copper), and the “Riflesso” effect, a unique ceramic technique whose secret has remained unknown for over a century.
column6:
Gloss

In the “Glossy Enamel Gloss” finish, Goccia is made by casting in clay and fired at 1000°C. After firing, it is glazed. The glossy enamel is opaque, available in different colors, and offers a very shiny surface. Since it is a handmade item, there may be slight imperfections, such as small dips or dots, which are part of its uniqueness. Each Goccia is therefore a one-of-a-kind and irreplaceable piece.

Watch the video >

Matt

The Matt Enamel finish is obtained through a special process that gives the surface a matte and soft touch. In this version as well, Goccia is made by casting and fired at 1000°C, then glazed by immersion and finished with an airbrush. The Matt glaze does not reflect light and may show small imperfections such as dips or tiny holes. This finish is available in various colors, and thanks to its characteristic, each Goccia is a unique piece.

Watch the video >

Metallic Colours

In the Metallic finish, the base remains Goccia, made by casting and fired at 1000°C. After this firing, a glossy vitrified glaze is applied, followed by the application of precious metals like 24k gold, pure platinum, or copper. These materials are applied by hand with a brush, and then the Goccia is fired at 700°C. Each piece is unique and precious due to this artisanal process. It may have small imperfections like dips or tiny holes.

Watch the full video >

Pearl (craquelé)

The family of pearl effect glazes naturally creates both a craquelé effect and a multitude of iridescences, which are typical of this type of finish. The microcracks created by this technique only affect the glassy surface and do not compromise the resistance or integrity of the ceramic or the speaker’s sound. These are made as refined aesthetic finishes for the material. Small imperfections like dips or tiny holes may be present.

Watch the video >

Riflesso

The Riflesso technique is an exclusive process from the Gatti workshop in Faenza. Each Goccia is made from liquid clay and fired at 1000°C, then glazed with a crystal finish. The final stage involves a third firing, in which acids, oxides, and precious metals are applied. This process creates a luminous and iridescent effect, with shades ranging from brown, red, orange, to green. As with all handcrafted pieces, each Goccia may show slight imperfections that highlight its value as a unique piece.

Watch the video >


Decor

Goccia™ in glazed white ceramic, hand-decorated in pure platinum. The Faentino decoration, designed in the 18th century, features a fantasy flower set in an Oriental-inspired garden, with a fence and lattice, adapted by the Faentine Majolica Masters onto the Goccia™ Garvan. It may have small imperfections like dips or tiny holes.

column6:
True Specifications

At BASSBOSS, with the MK3 line we have stopped using “Peak” and “RMS” power ratings for our amplifiers because those numbers alone are not an accurate representation of the real-world performance you can expect from our powered loudspeaker systems.

‍Peak Watts:

  • Essentially a theoretical maximum that the amplifiers could output for an instantaneous moment under ideal conditions with no load.

  • However, this peak power is not sustainable and has little practical relevance for how the loudspeakers will actually perform.

‍RMS (root mean square) Watts:

  • A measure of continuous power output, but even this figure doesn’t account for the true efficiency of how that power is converted into acoustic output by the transducers and overall speaker design.

  • The number of watts a loudspeaker “uses” is constantly fluctuating based on the impedance curve, frequency response, and heat generated in the voice coils.

  • Simply looking at how many watts an amplifier can produce on a test bench doesn’t translate to its real-world sound output capability.

‍What matters most is the complete integrated loudspeaker system and how efficiently it can convert the amplifier’s power into acoustic output while maintaining flat frequency response and headroom. Two loudspeakers with the same wattage ratings could have vastly different real-world sound pressure levels and clarity.

For these reasons, we believe wattage ratings alone are not a reliable metric. Listening tests and measurements of the overall system’s output capabilities like maximum SPL and distortion are far more telling than any peak or RMS wattage number viewed in isolation.

Our goal is to provide outstanding performance through intelligent system design, not just big wattage numbers.

column4: PASSIVE SUBWOOFER
column5:
Description

A low-profile passive subwoofer that delivers high-output low-frequency performance for dedicated home cinema installations. Can function as a supporting unit for an MX-20 system or operate independently in a Series SX configuration.

Its shallow depth enables discreet placement against walls. Features a large 380 mm driver with 100 mm edge-wound copper voice coil for maximum output in high-drive applications.

column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"lv74216770","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The AC-MX-42 is a 4x2 HDMI matrix switch. As a result, source devices fail to detect an active EDID-managed HDMI path. An AVR or Pre-processor may not fully activate or switch to the desired input for audio capture if no active output is detected or fails to enable proper input signal processing.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"ITALIC","italicData":true}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"xhjw616782","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"BEST PRACTICE is for the AVR or Pre-processor to terminate into a device that produces an active EDID, which serves to “trick” the AVR or Pre-processor into continuing to function as designed (with a video signal and multi-channel audio selected at one of its inputs, expected to transfer the video signal to a display device with EDID authentication). An AVPro Edge AC-SC-1X or AC-DA12-AUHD-GEN2 with EDID management is ideal for overcoming this anomaly as both have EDID management capabilities; however, any device capable of producing an EDID compatible with maintaining the AVR’s or Pre-processor’s stability may be utilized.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"ITALIC","italicData":true}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"b12j116806","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"uhwsj16812","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"​Ideal for overcoming AVR problems","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" - In today’s fast-moving, high-bandwidth video market, there is often a need to send high bit rate, bitstream audio into AVR’s to take advantage of audio advances like Dolby Atmos or DTS-X. column4: 10A Power Conditioner and Sequencer, 220V-240V. The most widely recognized and trusted name in AC power conditioning is proud to introduce the PS-8RE III power conditioner / sequencer, featuring Furman’s revolutionary SMP technology, LiFT, EVS and a high current TVZ-MOV.
column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"foo","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Furman's Series Multi-Stage Protection (SMP) circuit also features our exclusive Linear Filter Technology (LiFT) with Extreme Voltage Shutdown (EVS) and a high current TVZ-MOV. Together, these technologies comprise what is, without question, the world's most advanced and comprehensive transient voltage surge suppressor","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"},"indentation":0}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"q7xr93326","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"},"indentation":0}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"b6p9q3202","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"SMP (Series Multi-Stage Protection Plus)","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"oon223204","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"SMP surge suppression virtually eliminates service calls. Traditional surge suppression circuits sacrifice themselves when exposed to multiple transient voltage spikes, requiring the dismantling of your system, and repair of your surge suppressor. Not so with SMP. With Furman’s SMP, damaging transient voltages are safely absorbed, clamped and dissipated - no sacrificed parts, no service calls, no down time.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"p6rzv3396","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"bb40n3206","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Unique to Furman’s SMP is its unparalleled clamping voltage, even when tested beyond the grueling specifications of - USA/CIDA’s A-1-1 test. While other designs offer clamping voltages that are well above 300VAC peak (far beyond long accepted professional standards), Furman’s SMP clamps at 376VAC peak, 266 VAC RMS even when tested with multiple 6000VAC - 3000 Amp surges! This unprecedented level of protection is only available with Furman’s SMP technology.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"1015p3358","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"4355t3208","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"LiFT (Linear Filtering Technology)","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"j87jr3210","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Unfortunately, traditional AC filter/conditioners have been designed for unrealistic laboratory conditions. Prior technologies could actually harm audio and video performance more than they help, due to the resonant peaking of their antiquated, non-linear designs. Under certain conditions, these designs can actually add more than 10 dB of noise to the incoming AC line! Worse still, lost digital data, the need to reboot digital presets, or destroyed digital converters are frequently caused by excessive voltage spikes and AC noise contaminating the equipment ground. Furman’s SMP with LiFT takes another approach, ensuring optimal performance through linear filtering and no leakage to ground.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"nvkkj3441","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"z1ldi3212","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"E.V.S. column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"gj7nt19609","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Future-forward and backwards-compatible, the AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT brings HDBaseT Spec 3.0 capabilities into AVPro Edge intermediate range HDMI extenders. But any telling of AVPro Edge innovation history is incomplete without mention of the legendary AC-EX40-444-KIT, which debuted Invisible Compression Technology (ICT), our transformative in-house custom-engineered, compression-transparent, proprietary algorithm, revolutionizing HDMI extension technology while simultaneously establishing the reference standard for point-to-point transmission of UHD 4K60Hz 4:4:4 signals using copper category cabling.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"feh3j19611","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"8yx6719613","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT arrives configured in the same elegant form factor as class-leading HDMI extension stablemate, the AC-EX100-444-KIT. This uptick in chassis proportions provides the additional internal real estate necessary to implement a newly developed application-specific integrated circuit. This ASIC features AVPro Edge’s exclusive 18Gbps Bandwidth-Adaptable Output Configuration, giving residential and commercial integrators options for managing signal bandwidth to match installation infrastructure challenges. For new installations or where Category 6A or better (shielded is preferred) cabling with precision termination exists, the AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT flawlessly transports uncompressed HDMI 2.0 video up to 40 meters (131 ft). In applications encountering legacy Category 5-rated cabling, a compression option of 10.2 Gbps using ICT may be enabled, switch-selectable from a chassis-mounted toggle to ferry content up to 70 meters (230 ft). The Bandwidth-Adaptable Output Configuration also serves as a convenient fallback should content expected to passthrough the system uncompressed fails to do so for an unidentifiable reason.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"0txdd19615","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"qg2m519617","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The AC-EX-40-444-PLUS-KIT supports eARC signal transfer, along with Dolby Vision plus static and dynamic HDR metadata formats. They say legends can never be replaced…the AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT politely disagrees, awaiting the opportunity to excel in one of your legendary installations.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"6ghe519634","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"r03zx19638","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Bandwidth-Adaptable Output Configuration:","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" The AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT is designed for up to 18Gbps uncompressed video transport however, if an existing wiring infrastructure proves insufficient for passing 18Gbps, our Invisible Compression Technology (ICT) can be selected for use by a toggle switch, reducing output bandwidth to 10.2Gbps for content display.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"2aa7819644","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"0pm4d19645","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"ICT is an in-house custom-engineered, compression-transparent, proprietary algorithm that continues to uphold AVPro Edge’s reputation as the standard for video excellence in HDMI matrix switching and signal extension. An industry first at its debut, ICT continues as the class-leading solution for commercial and residential integrators seeking to maintain state-of-the-art image fidelity at system-detached display locations when bandwidth reduction becomes unavoidable. ICT’s specialty is spotlighted by what you won’t see, such as banding, color wash-out, or compression and motion artifacts.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"rthx519650","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"uipst19651","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Extend 4K60 4:4:4 With HDR Signals:","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" HDCP was conceived to assure content holders copy protection for their media. The 19 conductor HDMI format was designed to facilitate this process when transporting media between devices, using a total of 8, small gauge wires to handle video information with the bulk of those remaining devoted to system policing. It wasn’t envisioned that sources would be placed elsewhere than the immediate display location, and the first HDMI cable designs dramatically exemplified these inherent problems with a useable HDMI cable length barely exceeding fifteen feet. Over time, this thankfully has been addressed in a variety of well-sorted ways, including AVPro Edge Bullet Train cables. Still, there are no “on-site, made to length” HDMI cables however with unrivaled ease, the extraordinary AC-EX-100-444-KIT extends a high bandwidth UHD 4K source an impressive three hundred and twenty-eight feet (100 meters) including Dolby Vision, HDR10 or HDR10+.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"4qisb19657","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"akosa19658","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Near-Zero Latency: ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Latency is less than 8 microseconds, measurable but visually undetectable.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"6zlex19664","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"3oveg19665","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Downscaling:","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" Problem-solving scaling circuitry is incorporated into the AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT transmitter chassis, capable of rescaling UHD 4K (including HDR signals) to 1080P. When paired with an AVPro Edge HDMI matrix switcher, scaling with EDID management allows the extender to tailor signal delivery in the highest caliber image fidelity when legacy displays are retained.  The AC-EX40-444-KIT simplifies deployment and prevents diluted performance in a mixed system. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"hgsrt19671","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"ews8t19672","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Audio Extraction:","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" PCM 2 Channel L/R Audio can be extracted from the transmitter end through the TOSLINK digital output and sent to an AVR or distribution amplifier. NOTE: This port will only work when the source is set to output 2-Channel Audio. If downmixing is required, please see the AVPro Edge AC-AVDM-AUHD.  ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"jlowi19678","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"mpehw19679","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"eARC Support: ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"This is the first AVPro Edge extension kit to feature eARC, compatible with all high bitrate and immersive audio formats. eARC also makes HDCP “handshaking” between compatible products smoother without the frequent complications often associated with CEC.   ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"wre5519685","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"vjexk19686","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Onboard Troubleshooting:","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" Leave your Fox & Hound test kit behind in the shop? The AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT has you covered. When required, the transmitter can generate a 1080p or 4K test pattern to aid with wire verification, switcher configuration settings, or source viability.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"vwzas19692","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"s863r19693","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Comprehensive EDID Management:","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" Legacy HD displays are often retained for use in new installation projects and occasionally their dated EDIDs impart problems contending with present-day sources. Robust EDID control on the AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT enables juggling video resolutions and audio codec combinations for an EDID that provides a congenial match for reliable system operation. EDID Copy allows for acute copying and saving of a known, working EDID, for stable kit functionality and HDCP repeatability.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"y9yxs19699","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"majg019700","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Control Options:","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}},{"type":"BOLD","fontWeightValue":700}]}},{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":" Configurable, bidirectional control for IR & RS-232 signals provides a carefully nuanced added plus to the AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT, consolidating wiring to a solitary pull and mitigating the use of supplemental devices for a clean, efficient installation. Simplified control requirements can take advantage of the AC-EX40-444-PLUS-KIT’s I-PASS, forwarding commands directly from a control system IR-out port into the TX unit I-PASS input, proceeding to the receiving end and routing directly from the RX unit’s IR-out into the display’s IR input jack (if equipped) or through an attached IR emitter. ESD (electrostatic discharge) protection adds a welcomed layer of defense for all connected products.  ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}}],"metadata":{"version":1,"createdTimestamp":"2022-12-19T17:56:18.279Z","updatedTimestamp":"2022-12-19T17:56:18.279Z","id":"cb5a8199-1b45-4593-866a-cf828c803bc8"},"documentStyle":{}}

column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"foo","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Mounted behind acoustically transparent screens or as surrounds in a multi-channel setup, the Megaphonix In-Wall deliver effortless power and controlled dispersion to achieve the impact of a real cinema experience.","decorations":[]}}],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"},"indentation":0}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"snp4114317","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The Megaphonix In-Wall are designed specifically for in wall use in dedicated home cinemas.  Using high power handling and high sensitivity drivers, these speakers will deliver all the impact and dynamics you need for a real home cinema experience without the need for a big wattage power amplifier.","decorations":[]}}],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"JUSTIFY"}},"style":{},"id":"mvkb014323","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The 255mm bass driver has a 50mm voice coil and has been developed to offer low harmonic distortion, especially in the critical midband. column4: 70M 18Gbps HDBaseT Extender Kit
column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"9kw3822606","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The AC-EX70-444-KIT was one of the first HDMI-over-HDBaseT extension kits on the market to transmit 4K/60fps 4:4:4 video signals. HDR10, plus dynamic metadata formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10+, and Hybrid Log Gamma, are transported over Cat6A copper cabling at 18Gbps, as image fidelity remains damage-free from source to display. Employing AVPro Edge’s proprietary Invisible Compression Technology algorithm, ICT, 4K/60fps signals containing high dynamic range video enhancements, with high-bitrate audio codecs, remain unaltered and artifact-free from the transport process.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{"background":"rgb(255, 255, 255)"}}]}}],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"urlbu22610","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"r6a9p22623","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"It is not unusual for other products in the marketplace to use algorithms designed for use by applications accustomed to significantly lower data amounts. As a consequence, combined with category cable use, image information must be forfeited to achieve sending the signal to the display.
