column4: 16A SmartSequencing Power Conditioner, 230V. SmartSequencing with advanced AC protection and noise filtration.
column5: {"nodes":[{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"foo","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Designed for Commercial A/V Installations in 220V-240V regions, the CN-3600 SE combines robust control capabilities via SmartSequencing™ Technology, advanced AC protection, and AC noise filtration.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"},"indentation":0}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"8hzf73127","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The new CN-3600 SE is one of the first products to feature Furman’s SmartSequencing™ technology, which allows large and complex A/V systems to be safely powered on and off with a simple press of a button or turn of a key, even by nontechnical personnel. SmartSequencing’s bidirectional communications between installed units enables a primary unit to control and sequence multiple secondary units, ensuring multizone electronic systems are powered on and off safely and dependably from a single control point across an entire installation. Units can be connected via current loop at runs of more than 1,000 feet with backwards compatibility with Furman’s legacy sequencers.","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"6dmf13129","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"In addition, the CN-3600 SE offers robust control options, equipped with RS-232 ports and command sets for integration with control systems. ","decorations":[{"type":"COLOR","colorData":{}}]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"}],"metadata":{"version":1,"createdTimestamp":"2022-12-19T17:56:18.279Z","updatedTimestamp":"2022-12-19T17:56:18.279Z","id":"e72c4d16-5688-4bac-93b7-ef37983a8aa9"},"documentStyle":{}}

column6:
True Specifications

At BASSBOSS, with the MK3 line we have stopped using “Peak” and “RMS” power ratings for our amplifiers because those numbers alone are not an accurate representation of the real-world performance you can expect from our powered loudspeaker systems.

Peak Watts:

  • Essentially a theoretical maximum that the amplifiers could output for an instantaneous moment under ideal conditions with no load.

  • However, this peak power is not sustainable and has little practical relevance for how the loudspeakers will actually perform.

‍RMS (root mean square) Watts:

  • A measure of continuous power output, but even this figure doesn’t account for the true efficiency of how that power is converted into acoustic output by the transducers and overall speaker design.

  • The number of watts a loudspeaker “uses” is constantly fluctuating based on the impedance curve, frequency response, and heat generated in the voice coils.

  • Simply looking at how many watts an amplifier can produce on a test bench doesn’t translate to its real-world sound output capability.

What matters most is the complete integrated loudspeaker system and how efficiently it can convert the amplifier’s power into acoustic output while maintaining flat frequency response and headroom. Two loudspeakers with the same wattage ratings could have vastly different real-world sound pressure levels and clarity.

For these reasons, we believe wattage ratings alone are not a reliable metric. Listening tests and measurements of the overall system’s output capabilities like maximum SPL and distortion are far more telling than any peak or RMS wattage number viewed in isolation.

Our goal is to provide outstanding performance through intelligent system design, not just big wattage numbers.

column4: 5.25-inch 2-way indoor/outdoor speaker, black or white
column5:
Modest sound requirements with wonderful performance.

The Nice OE5 One Outdoor Elements speaker addresses a multitude of exterior applications and is available in black or white. A single 5.25" IMG cone woofer loaded into a ported enclosure dramatically enhances low-frequency response for deep, full bass that complements any type of music.

  • One 5.25" IMG cone woofer with rubber surround for full, deep bass

  • One pivoting 1" liquid-cooled treated silk dome tweeter

  • Ported enclosure that enhances low-frequency response

Built for the outdoors

  • Drivers made from space-age polymers, injection-molded graphite or aluminum for sonic purity

  • Timbre-matched across all three Outdoor Elements series speakers

  • 4 Ohm impedance with 100W power handling

A compact, high-fidelity indoor/outdoor speaker ideal for patios, decks and covered exterior spaces.

column3: Magic Cube Aura Wired Plus BLE 5 and WiFi 6
column4: Magic Cube Aura Wired Plus BLE 5 and WiFi 6
column5:
This is the Magic Cube Aura with built-in WiFi 6, and BLE 5 adapters.  It’s also the upgraded unit with 4GB RAM to keep all applications humming nicely.  It’s practically on steroids and uppers 24/7.

The Magic Cube Aura is a Professional Level robust device that uses real-time communications between Nice and hundreds of devices by providing a middleware hardware that translates commands from Nice to the devices.

It’s lighting fast and provides all the necessary technology to be able to control many devices around the home or business.

A Magic Cube can run multiple drivers and multiple instances of the same driver.
column6:
This version of the Magic Cube comes equipped with

  • 4GB RAM

  • 2.5GBPS Ethernet Connection

  • BLE 5.0

  • WiFi 6.0

The Built in Bluetooth allows you to control bluetooth lights, sensors, curtain openers from Nice.  Discover the power of Bluetooth sensors and lights.

You can still add Zigbee and ZWave adapters to this unit.  See Below for options.

If you need more than 5 units, please reach out to sales@innovo.net with a PO.

column4: 4K Video over IP receiver with analog audio breakout
column5:
Premium 4K video distribution over standard 1Gb network architecture.

The Nice EL-4K-VIP-RX is an HDCP 2.2 compliant Video over IP (VIP) receiver that uses visually lossless compression technology to deliver HDMI, bi-directional IR, RS-232 and USB/KVM up to 100m over a standard network. It pairs with the EL-4K-VIP-TX transmitter and can be powered via PoE or locally, making it ideal for both residential and commercial installations.

  • Advanced UHD video over a 1Gb network with virtually unlimited system size

  • Supports up to 4K HDR UHD video (3840 x 2160 @30Hz 4:4:4, 4096 x 2160 @24Hz 4:4:4, and 4K @60Hz 4:2:0)

  • Supports all known HDMI audio formats including Dolby TrueHD, Dolby Digital Plus and DTS-HD Master Audio

Flexible operation

  • Four operational modes: matrix distribution, video wall, one-to-one HDMI extender, and one-to-many HDMI splitter

  • Analog L/R audio breakout, video up- and down-scaling, and advanced EDID management

  • Bi-directional RS-232 and IR pass-through plus USB 2.0 connectivity for KVM and other devices

Simple configuration via the web GUI through the EL-4K-VIP-ACM, with RS-232, IR and Telnet/IP integration for full system control.

Though the need for pristine AC power is nothing new, the Elite-10 E i's technology and its unique implementation are revolutionary and without peer.","decorations":[]}}],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"},"indentation":0}},{"type":"PARAGRAPH","id":"bdpda2454","nodes":[],"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"},"indentation":0}},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"7q8cp2422","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"The extreme AC demands encountered in the professional audio/video arena have required technological developments far in excess of typical home theater/audiophile power products. In studios, live sound, and broadcast facilities, breakdown is unacceptable. Equipment failure or poor performance is costly. The same is true of today's home theater. Our solution based technology, extensive engineering expertise, and robust build quality have answered the challenge of today's corrupted power lines, and led to the creation of the Elite-10 E I.","decorations":[]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"7pyoe2465","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"dqpa32424","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Today's power lines are plagued with RF and EMI noise. When connecting sensitive equipment to your home's power outlet, AC noise couples into your system's critical components. This noise masks low level signals and cripples performance. Low level content is critical because it relays the crucial harmonics and ambience in audio, as well as the depth and clarity in video. With Furman's exclusive Linear Filtering Technology, televisions, projectors, DVD players, amplifiers, and processors are fed linearly-filtered AC power. This dramatically reduces noise, ensuring consistent peak operation regardless of load conditions or the time of day. For the first time, you will see and hear your theater or audio system as it should be — uncompromised.","decorations":[]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"sg2ck2485","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"m84a82426","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Another critical feature is our exclusive Series Multi-Stage Protection. This virtually maintenance-free surge suppression assures the highest level of AC protection possible, without sacrificing itself when the offending surge is severe — no damaged equipment, no service calls, no down time. Our digital AC voltage meter allows precise measurement of the incoming AC line voltage, (a valuable asset when monitoring systems that are connected to today's potentially poor power grids).","decorations":[]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"0uaed2493","nodes":[],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"5gai52428","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"Further, our famous retractable front panel LED lamps allow easy viewing of either a rack or cabinet full of equipment, even when your theater lights are off.","decorations":[]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"},{"paragraphData":{"textStyle":{"textAlignment":"AUTO"}},"style":{},"id":"eybpj2430","nodes":[{"type":"TEXT","id":"","nodes":[],"textData":{"text":"When employing the Elite-10 E i, you will notice far clearer, stunningly focused sound and visual images from your system. Video presentation will be crisp and colors true with greater gray and black scale definition, as well as noticeably improved depth and clarity. Many of the technological advances previously available only in our flagship Reference Conditioners are cornerstones of the Elite series. Now everyone can reap the benefits of unrivaled power purification and unequalled surge protection.","decorations":[]}}],"type":"PARAGRAPH"}],"metadata":{"version":1,"createdTimestamp":"2022-12-19T17:56:18.279Z","updatedTimestamp":"2022-12-19T17:56:18.279Z","id":"9971ad25-20f8-4eec-909e-73b33d6274a7"},"documentStyle":{}}

18mm plywood cabinet
Bass reflex design
Get it in black or white
column5:
High output passive subwoofer

C15i is a subwoofer designed for custom installation in rooms over 80 sqm. in in- and semi outdoor applications. The reflex loaded cabinet features a 15” woofer with an advanced motor. The 75 mm Ø aluminum voice coil employs the interleaved sandwich voice coil with windings on both the outer and inner surfaces to achieve a mass- balanced coil. The results in a linear motor with excellent control and very low distortion even at maximum output. The magnetic structure has been optimized using FEA CAD resource that maximized the flux density in the voice coil gap for optimized clarity. Excellent heat dissipation has also been achieved by incorporating air channels between the basket and the magnetic top plate reducing power compression significantly and thereby improving dynamics. C15i is designed to be driven by the Cornered DSP amplifiers.

column4: Passive 12-inch coaxial installation loudspeaker
column5:
AIR-122 is a passive installation system based on a 12-inch coaxial woofer. Compact size, light weight, and numerous mounting options make AIR-122 a high-usability system that achieves maximum performance per occupied space.

  • 12-inch coaxial driver with 96 dB sensitivity and 132 dB max SPL

  • 80 x 80 degrees nominal coverage angle

  • VESA 100 x 100, dual M10 fly points, and M10 safety point

With a small visual footprint, the AIR-C24 is a high-performing system with two 4” woofers and an HF driver on a rotatable horn. It is compatible with horizontal and vertical adjustable mountings and is available in 8 Ohm for ease of parallel usage.

column6:
The ProAudio 16RS is a new version of our ever-popular ProAudio 16 audio matrix switch, with the added flexibility of supporting 8 digital inputs located up to 200m away (Remote Source) over a Cat5e/6 cable.

The ProAudio 16RS DSP Pre-Amp Audio Matrix features 48 audio inputs alongside 16 analogue outputs and 16 digital outputs, enabling simultaneous audio distribution to multiple zones. Each output zone can be enhanced with built-in features including 5-band equaliser on each zone, adjustable volume and gain settings, subwoofer control, serial and TCP/IP control, lip sync delay and much more.

 

ProAudio has been designed for the custom install AV market, in many cases the need for an audio receiver can be eliminated by using the audio features of the ProAudioTM Series.

column6:
Kicks Some Serious Ash

Engineered to deliver explosive impact from the smallest space possible, this single loudspeaker covers the entire audible spectrum. The Krakatoa focuses its output of seismic bass, crystal-clear highs, and everything in between, from a single point.



Seismic Sound

The Krakatoa delivers all sounds seamlessly from a single point. This ensures the most naturally realistic listening experience that a loudspeaker can produce. Practically eliminating phase interference affords superior sound localization, which allows more precise imaging, immersing listeners in an immense, sharply focused sound field. This is the real immersive.



Volcanic Volume

The Krakatoa is a true full range – from deep, powerful bass to crisp highs, delivering every note with clarity and precision. Its 4-way design assigns each frequency range to dedicated drivers, reducing distortion and ensuring balanced, dynamic sound even at high volumes. How big does it sound? If you hear it before you see it, you won't believe how small it is...


You'll Lava It!

The Stack-a-Toa combines the Kraken Quad 21” Subwoofer, the Makara Double 21” Subwoofer, and the Krakatoa into a vertically stacked powerhouse of sound, delivering massive SPL from a remarkably small “dance stack” design.

column4: Amplifier
column5: The Stealth Acoustics SA2400-MKII is a high-current two-channel amplifier with powerful built-in digital signal processing functions suitable as a low distortion power source for Stealth Acoustics speakers, Stealth subwoofers, or other un-powered speakers and subwoofers. Intended for distributed audio, fixed installations, or home theater applications, the SA2400-MKII mounts using the supplied removable rack ears in a standard 19” (482 mm) equipment rack requiring only two RU spaces (3-1/2” – 89 mm), or may stack with other free-standing components. The SA2400-MKII delivers a solid 310 watts per-channel into an 8Ω load and 450 watts per-channel into 4Ω.
column6:
The SA2400-MKII’s internal DSP functions may be programmed for each channel independently or together and include 11 bands of fully-parametric EQ, variable High and Low Pass filters with selectable slopes, fully-programmable limiter stage and delay functions. All parameters may be programmed using front panel controls or via a USB connected computer utilizing Stealth Signal Management System software (SSMS).

For maximum flexibility integrating into any audio system, the SA2400-MKII includes RCA unbalanced line level, balanced XLR line level, and phoenix speaker level inputs for each channel, all with “pass-through” output connectors. Line level pass through outputs may be programmed as either “pre” or “post” DSP feeds to facilitate extending DSP tuning to additional amplifiers. The speaker level input/pass-through connections allow the SA2400-MKII to feed directly from full-range speaker lines, anywhere in the system and will track the speaker’s output level. A stereo optical input is provided for connecting digital sources to the amplifier. Inputs may be mapped to either channel and may be “mono-summed” via programming. The SA2400-MKII amplifier output connections are via 5-way binding posts designed to accept heavy gauge speaker wires.

10 internal, remotely re-callable, read-write presets allow the amplifier to quickly change profile states for different modes of usage, or to load factory speaker optimization curves for Stealth invisible and environmental speakers and subwoofers. Users may store and recall unlimited amplifier profile files via the SSMS App. A selectable automatic turn-on feature activates the amplifier only when audio signals are present, or the 12V trigger function may be utilized to activate and deactivate the amplifier, along with other system components. The IR control functionality also allows for remote control of master volume and preset selection via most 3rd-party control systems. Quiet 8-stage cooling fans automatically engage as required. The front panel includes direct master volume and menu access controls as well as an LCD display window and dual clip indicators. 115VAC through 230VAC 50/60 input line voltages are automatically accommodated via the auto-sensing IEC power inlet. The Stealth Acoustics SA2400-MKII amplifier is covered by a 2-Year manufacturer’s warranty.

column4: IN-WALL SPEAKER
column5: Designed for use as both fronts and surrounds, the IW-30 will disappear into the room, leaving you to enjoy the soundtrack.
column6:
The IW-30 is a compact in-wall speaker, ideal for creating a two channel music or multichannel home theatre experience. With performance surpassing its size, the IW-30 is well suited to small to medium home theatre rooms as main or surround speakers, or as a left and right pair for stereo music.

As a rectangular in-wall version of the in-ceiling IC-30 (Hemispherix AS) and IC-32 (Hemispherix A20) speakers, the IW-30 offers precise tonal matching, but will also provide excellent synergy with any of the Krix speaker range. Designed to fit within a 70mm wall cavity, its fully enclosed back box ensures acoustic integrity and prevents rear sound radiation from being transferred to adjoining rooms.

Bass and midrange clarity are delivered through the 100mm bass driver, while the 20mm ring radiator tweeter sits within an integrated waveguide for improved dispersion. The single piece trimless grille is held in place by magnets at the front of the speaker, and can be painted to match the decor of any room.

For the ultimate sound experience at home, play it through Krix.

column6:
Description

8" Two-way, dual tweeter stereo input rock loudspeaker, with living-room-quality sound outdoors. Can be used in mono, two-speaker stereo, or single-speaker stereo input. Has a natural Gray Granite finish and NoFade protective paint and weatherproof design that surpasses military standard 883 for corrosion resistance.

8" injection-molded TCC  filled polypropylene cone is extremely rigid to reduce breakup and lower distortion. Designed for extreme environmental conditions and both UV exposure and water resistance. Artistically crafted cabinet with shaped MicroPerf aluminum grilles looks natural and realistic. Cone Forward design positions drivers close to the grille and ensures intelligible midrange. Colors: Granite (shown), Sandstone, Shale Brown, and Speckled Granite.

column4: 4K 18Gbps HDBaseT ARC extender kit, up to 100m (4K to 70m)
column5:
Outstanding value HDBaseT extension powered up to 100m (4K to 70m).

The Nice EL-4KHDBT-KIT-70-ARC-18G is an HDMI 2.0 4K 60Hz 4:4:4 (18Gbps), HDCP 2.2 HDBaseT ARC extender kit that uses CSC technology to deliver uncompressed video and audio with zero latency. The matched transmitter and receiver extend HDMI, bi-directional IR and RS-232 over a single CAT cable.

  • Advanced HDBaseT technology delivering uncompressed video and audio with zero latency

  • Extends HDMI 4K60 4:4:4 up to 70m, and 1080p up to 100m, over a single CAT cable

  • Supports 4K UHD video (3840 x 2160 @30Hz 4:4:4, 4096 x 2160 @24Hz 4:4:4, and 4K @60Hz 4:2:0)

Audio, control and power

column4: 20-CHANNEL IMMERSIVE SOUND RECEIVER
column5:
Description

The ISR Fusion 20 is the first 20-channel immersive sound receiver on the market, integrating StormAudio's reference processing platform with 16 channels of the latest ICEpower Edge amplification developed in Denmark. It pairs the DSP horsepower to decode up to 11.1.8 immersive layouts with the muscle to drive a full Atmos array out of a single chassis.

The most advanced implementation of Dirac Live Active Room Treatment ensures accurate calibration, while up to 20 PEQs per channel, four-way active crossovers and unlimited subwoofer support give integrators full control over even the most ambitious systems.

column4: REFERENCE IMMERSIVE SOUND PROCESSOR
column5:
Description

The ISP Elite MK3 is StormAudio's reference immersive sound processor — a modular, future-proof platform that took 'Best New Home Cinema Sound Processor of 2022' and continues to set the bar. Engineered around a software-defined hardware strategy, every major subsystem (HDMI, audio outputs, processing) is upgradeable, so the chassis you install today keeps pace with format and connectivity changes for years.

Up to 24 channels of decoding and upmixing — and up to 32 channels of post-processing — handle Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D and IMAX Enhanced. Seven HDMI inputs with HDMI 2.1a / HDCP 2.3 support 8K at 40 Gbps and full HDR10+, Dolby Vision and HLG pass-through.

The full Dirac Live suite — Live, Bass Control, Bass Management and Active Room Treatment (DLART) — comes standard, with model variants delivering 16, 24 or 32 analog XLR channels, or 32 digital AES/EBU or AoIP (AES67/Dante) outputs for the most ambitious installations.

column4: 8-CHANNEL POWER AMPLIFIER
column5:
Description

The PA 8 Ultra MK3 is StormAudio's 8-channel reference amplifier — engineered with Pascal Audio and built around UMAC Class D modules paired with four individual UREC power supplies delivering up to 3 kW of total power capacity. It is the heart of an immersive system, pumping 200 W per channel into 8 ohms or 400 W into 4 ohms across all eight channels.

When bigger SPLs or LCR/subwoofer duty calls, four bridged BTL channels deliver up to 800 W RMS at 8 ohms with 32 dB of gain. THD+N is held below 0.005% at 1 W and signal-to-noise sits at 115 dB, with frequency response extending from 10 Hz to 50 kHz (-3 dB CEM).

Ethernet remote monitoring via StormMonitoring, USB service access and 12 V triggers tie it cleanly into any StormAudio ISP-based system.

column4: 16-CHANNEL POWER AMPLIFIER
column5:
Description

Real Power for Real Immersive Systems. The PA 16 MK3 is a 16-channel high-power Class D amplifier that delivers authority and balance without strain — sixteen channels of clean output that keep blockbuster action scenes controlled while preserving every subtle detail in the mix.

Like its 8-channel sibling, it pairs UMAC Class D modules with four UREC power supplies for up to 3 kW of headroom on tap. Each channel delivers 200 W into 8 ohms or 225 W into 4 ohms across all sixteen channels driven, with bridged BTL operation pushing up to 800 W per channel for LCRs or subwoofers.

THD+N stays below 0.005% at 1 W, signal-to-noise hits 115 dB, and the frequency response runs 10 Hz – 50 kHz. Sixteen balanced XLR inputs, Ethernet for remote monitoring and 12 V triggers make it a drop-in match for StormAudio's ISP/ISR platforms — all in a standard 19-inch 3U chassis with electronically controlled, near-silent ventilation.

column4: DIRAC LIVE ROOM-CALIBRATION KIT
column5:
Description

StormAudio's Calibration Kit is the full-fat tool every StormAudio integrator brings on site. Built around a calibrated USB measurement microphone and supplied in a custom flight case, it contains everything required to run a complete Dirac Live Room Correction, Bass Control, and Active Room Treatment session on any StormAudio ISP or ISR processor.

The kit ships with a microphone stand and boom, USB and USB-over-CAT5 cabling, and a powered USB/CAT5 extender so the mic can reach the prime listening position from anywhere in the room. The flight case has empty space for additional small equipment so installers can carry a single, organized rig between projects.

Designed to be used with the StormAudio-licensed build of Dirac Live, it produces the measurement data StormAudio's Pro Remote Assisted Calibration (PRAC) service expects — making it the only calibration hardware StormAudio formally endorses for field use.

column4: COMPACT CALIBRATION & MONITORING MIC KIT
column5:
Description

The Microphone Mini-Kit is StormAudio's permanent in-room microphone solution, supplied with every new StormAudio processor and available as a spare or replacement SKU. It pairs a calibrated USB measurement microphone with a discreet pod and a USB-over-CAT5 extender, so the mic can live permanently at the prime listening position and feed back into the processor whenever calibration or RTA is needed.

Beyond Dirac Live calibration, the Mini-Kit unlocks StormAudio's remote monitoring and Real-Time Analysis features, letting the integrator audit speaker behaviour and re-run calibration from anywhere without ever bringing a flight case back on site. It is the recommended companion to every ISP Elite MK3, ISP Core 16, ISP Evo, and ISR Fusion 20 install.

CUE Si is the in-wall version of CUE S, designed for fully concealed installations behind acoustically transparent surfaces. Utilizing the same dual 2 in woofers, passive radiators, and 1 in high-frequency driver as the surface-mounted model, CUE Si achieves identical tonal balance and clarity while maintaining a more discreet visual presence.

  • 2 x 2 in woofers + 2 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 105 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Concealed in-wall installation, 4 Ohm

column4: Ultra-slim passive on-wall subwoofer
column5:
CUE Sub is an ultra-slim, on-wall subwoofer designed to extend low-frequency performance in architectural installations without occupying floor space. Featuring dual 8 in drivers firing directly into the wall, it delivers controlled, punchy bass while remaining physically safe and visually discreet. Supplied with an integrated mounting bracket.

  • Dual 8 in drivers with 1.5 in voice coils

  • 122 dB max SPL, 45-200 Hz response, 400 W

  • Ultra-slim on-wall enclosure with integrated bracket

column4: Ultra-slim surface-mount column speaker (flagship)
column5:
CUE L is the flagship column of the CUE Series. Six woofers combined with four passive radiators deliver enhanced low-frequency weight, paired with the shared 1 in tweeter. Engineered for demanding installations requiring higher SPL, extended coverage, and authoritative presence. Suitable for clubs, performance spaces, and large public interiors.

  • 6 x 2 in woofers + 4 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 114.5 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Aluminum enclosure, 12 Ohm, 150 W

column4: Ultra-slim surface-mount column speaker (medium)
column5:
CUE M is the balanced workhorse of the CUE Series, offering increased output and coverage while maintaining a slim architectural profile. With four woofers, dual passive radiators, and the same high-resolution 1 in tweeter used across the series, CUE M provides confident midrange projection and controlled low frequencies. Well-suited for bars, restaurants, galleries, and medium-scale spaces.

  • 4 x 2 in woofers + 2 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 111 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Aluminum enclosure, 8 Ohm, 100 W

column4: Ultra-slim surface-mount column speaker (compact)
column5:
CUE S is the most compact loudspeaker within the CUE Series lineup. Dual 2 in woofers, dual passive radiators, and a precision 1 in high-frequency driver deliver articulate sound with surprising low-end presence for its size. Suits intimate venues, corridors, lounges, and architectural accents.

  • 2 x 2 in woofers + 2 x passive radiators + 1 in tweeter

  • 105 dB max SPL, 120 degrees horizontal coverage

  • Aluminum enclosure, 4 Ohm, 50 W

column4: High-output passive line array module (R series)
column5:
FLY-R60 is a potent passive line array solution featuring four 6.5 in woofers and two 1.4 in high-frequency transducers. Engineered for short to medium-throw applications, delivering 70 degrees horizontal coverage with a 0 degree vertical splay angle for controlled dispersion. Integrated flying hardware enables flexible mounting.

  • 4 x 6.5 in LF drivers and 2 x 1.4 in HF drivers

  • 125 dB max SPL, 70 degrees H coverage, 0 degree V splay

  • 600 W power handling, 8 Ohm

column4: High-output passive line array module, wider coverage
column5:
FLY-R68 is engineered for short and medium-throw applications, featuring four 6.5 in woofers and two 1.4 in high-frequency drivers. It delivers 110 degrees horizontal coverage with an 8 degree vertical splay angle, providing tightly controlled dispersion and high intelligibility.

  • 4 x 6.5 in LF drivers and 2 x 1.4 in HF drivers

  • 125 dB max SPL, 110 degrees H coverage, 8 degree V splay

  • 600 W power handling, 8 Ohm

column4: Passive cardioid line array subwoofer
column5:
FLY-R8B is a passive cardioid subwoofer engineered for concert halls, theaters, and clubs. A unique six-driver configuration with four front-firing and two rear-firing 8 in woofers achieves up to -16 dB rear cancellation, reducing stage noise and focusing sound toward the audience.

  • Six 8 in drivers (4 front-firing + 2 rear-firing)

  • Cardioid pattern with up to -16 dB rear cancellation

  • 127 dB max SPL, 45-200 Hz response

column4: Universal flying frame for HORNET 12 arrays
column5:
HTF-01 is a universal flying frame for HORNET arrays, enabling linear array installation. Lightweight and transportable, it supports up to 16 Hornet 12 units and is suited for wall, ceiling, indoor, and outdoor mounting. Accessory, not a loudspeaker.

  • Compatible with HORNET 12 arrays, up to 16 units

  • Lightweight 30 kg construction

  • Suitable for wall, ceiling, indoor and outdoor mounting
